visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and thick white-rimmed glasses speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit room with white walls. He wears a white t-shirt featuring a detailed colorful graphic of a blue creature on a boat. He holds a triangular object with a black-and-white face featuring the character '東' (East). He demonstrates opening a brown cardboard box which contains a white plastic holder and the black-and-white tiles. (2) The scene cuts between the man talking and close-up product shots. A high-angle shot shows the triangular indicator resting on a white surface next to green mahjong tiles. Later, the man is seen outdoors at night with bright golden sparks/fireworks raining down in the background. This is followed by a scene in a crowded mahjong parlor where multiple people are seated around automatic mahjong tables. (3) The man walks along a sidewalk with grey paving stones and enters a retail store. The interior is filled with gaming merchandise, consoles, and posters. He interacts with a woman who has vibrant pink hair and glasses. He points out various game boxes including 'Elden Ring' and 'Death Stranding 2' on the shelves. The woman holds the black-and-white indicator while gesturing. The video ends with a close-up of a red promotional poster for Nintendo Switch 2.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator speaking over an upbeat, major-key pop-rock background track with steady percussion and synthesized melodies. At 0:17, the distinct crinkling sound of a cardboard box and paper rustling occurs as the narrator handles packaging. (2) At 0:29, a crisp mechanical 'click' or 'snap' is heard as a plastic component is inserted into a base. This triggers a short transitional sound effect. The narrator's speech remains brisk and informative, exhibiting high clarity and positive valence. (3) A loud 'whoosh' transition at 0:56 marks a change in background texture, followed by the clacking and shuffling of mahjong tiles—a percussive, high-frequency sound bed—around 1:03. (4) At 1:59, the male narrator shouts an enthusiastic greeting ('Konnichiwa'), followed by a female voice responding in a friendly, high-pitched tone. The background ambience shifts to include muffled store chatter and a slight change in reverb, reflecting a retail environment. (5) Final mechanical clicks and the thud of items being placed on a counter are heard at 2:15, accompanied by the consistent energetic BGM which maintains the video's momentum until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Demo -> Sales History -> Location Listings -> Partner Visit -> Final Call-to-Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the relaunch of a specialized Mahjong wind indicator accessory. The video highlights the product's design, magnetic functionality, and reduced price point compared to previous versions, while providing specific dates and locations (mahjong parlors and game stores) where fans can purchase the limited edition item and meet the creator.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host holds the product throughout the video, demonstrates its use, mentions specific pricing ($990), and lists exact store locations for purchase.
